endangerment.comment: Dungan (4096-dng) = Vulnerable (100 percent certain, based on the evidence available) (Dungan language class is offered in school within the Dungan communities, and code-switching between Dungan and Russian is very common due to widespread bilingualism. People who live outside the Dungan communities begin to shift to Russian.) [Hai 2003](cldf:hai:03)
